provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-aligned batch (2026-10-21): rules shaped by the Main App response surface
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A service response carries the Symfony debug exception class that DPK-DAST-298 declares.

groundTruth.rationale: The synthetic response reproduces the exact evidence DPK-DAST-298 inspects, with a realistic status code and content type for that failure mode.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
A positive case proves the rule fires on this evidence; it is not a claim that a live target behaves the same way.
The evidence string avoids the backslash separators in the class name because the evaluator compares it against the JSON-serialised observation, where backslashes are escaped.
